title: Polaroid Land Camera 1000
note: Polaroid's integral-film box camera (1977), built to show how it works from the outside in: the plastic shell, the front plate with lens, shutter, viewfinder and controls, the light box with its 45-degree mirror, the SX-70 film pack with its battery, and the spread rollers, pick and motor that push the print out. Frame: z up, camera bottom at z = 0, centred in x and y; the model faces -y (the lens looks along -y, the button on -x), as Perseverance's forward. The positions in from_photos and estimates are in the camera's own frame (lens along +y, button on +x): the build turns the model 180 degrees about z at the end. Real size in metres. The side profile and front parts are measured from Halicki's photos through cameras fitted to the documented 107 x 140 mm footprint; internal parts are estimates (open_questions).

reference_model.note: none: no free 3D model of the 1000 found; layout from photos

conflict.note: axis order not stated; 94 read as height. 2 mm apart; whether either includes the eyecup is not stated (open_questions)

body_height.note: the eyecup is the highest point (halicki_2023 (2) cast: 95-97 mm); 94 used

also.quote: a one element 103mm f/14.6 plastic lens, fixed focus

print_format.note: the print; the cassette is a little larger (not found)

housing.value: three plastic parts: the body box (with the strap), the front plate (lens, viewfinder, lighten/darken control, button) and the film door; front plate and box hook together with two barbed tongues; the door is held by the mechanism inside, not the housing
housing.quote: Das Plasikgehäuse der Kamera besteht aus drei Teilen: dem Kamerakasten mit dem Tragegurt, der Frontplatte mit Objektiv, Sucher, Helligkeitsregler und Auslöser und der Klappe für die Filmkassette.

light_path.value: fixed plastic lens, shutter behind it, then a light-tight box with a mirror at 45 degrees that turns the image through 90 degrees onto the film in the pack
light_path.quote: einem lichtdichten Kasten mit Spiegel, der das von der Linse eingefangene Bild um 90° reflektiert auf den Film in der Filmkassette projiziert ... im Kamerakasten im 45°-Winkel angebrachten Spiegel

viewfinder.value: a separate tube from the eyepiece on the body to the front plate, with a lens set in its front
viewfinder.quote: Der Sucher geht von einem Okular am Gehäuse bis zur Frontplatte. In die Front des Suchers ist eine Linse eingelassen.

shutter_and_eject.value: mechanical shutter, electric print eject; two contact clips in the film bay take power from the battery in the pack
shutter_and_eject.quote: Der Verschluss ist mechanisch, der Bildauswurf ist elektrisch. Zwei im Cassettenfach befestigte Kontaktklemmen leiten den Strom aus der in der Cassette eingebauten Batterie in die Kameraelektrik.

battery.value: six-volt flat battery inside each film pack
battery.quote: power is provided by a six-volt battery inside the film pack

also.quote: Contains a battery to power your camera.

pack_springs.value: the pack is held by springs on the bay floor; the print is pushed out by a roller mechanism
pack_springs.quote: Die Filmcassette wird durch am Boden angebrachte Spannfedern fixiert, das Bild durch eine Rollenmechanik ausgeworfen.

rollers_and_pick.value: a pick pushes the exposed film into two spread rollers, which break the pod, spread the developer and drive the print out; one (top) roller is geared to the motor's gear train
rollers_and_pick.quote: the picks feeds the exposed film to the spreader rolls. The rolls break the pod, spread the developer, and eject the film from the camera. ... The front cover idler gear meshing with the gear train powers the top roller

also.quote: photo 'Rollenmechanik': a gold roller with a spur gear on a steel frame, a plain steel roller, and a brass pick/spring plate

motor_side.value: motor beside one side of the film cassette, rollers beside the opposite side, gear train along a third side (SX-70 patent; the 1000's photos to confirm)
motor_side.quote: Motive power is derived from an electric motor 130 attached to the rear portion of frame 12

also.quote: Pull the electric motor straight out of the plastic piece. ... Remove the solenoid from the back of the lens plate by removing the two tabs.

frame_counter.value: a white dial numbered 10 down to 0 beside the shutter mechanism
frame_counter.quote: photo 'Verschluss, Mechanik und Elektrik': white counter dial reading 10, 9; brass contact fingers, a flex foil, a red and a black wire

variants.value: sold as the OneStep in the US; red or green button; Q-light flash made for it
variants.quote: In the United States, it was marketed as the OneStep. ... They had two unique shutter colors: red and green.

stripe_bands.value: five bands on the Supercolor 1000 (magenta, orange, yellow, green, blue); the earlier 1000 and the OneStep have six (pink, red, orange, yellow, green, blue)

open_questions: Variant: the white Supercolor 1000 with the rainbow stripe (decided by David, 2026-11-05), from Halicki's CC BY-SA 4.0 photos.
Retronautik's teardown photos (no licence stated) are used to measure the inside parts from, not as textures, and stay out of refs/ (David, 2026-11-05).

No published size for any internal part (mirror, light box, rollers, motor, gears, pack thickness). They will be estimated from the teardown photos, scaled by the 88 mm print width, and labelled as estimates.
Overall size: Hackney 92 x 107 x 140 mm vs Kamerastore 141 x 109 x 94 mm (axis order not stated); whether the eyecup is included is not stated.
Front features (lens surround, viewfinder window, button, knob, exit slot) have no published sizes: to be measured from Halicki (3), scaled by the 107 mm width.
Mechanism details (motor type, solenoids, gear count, circuit layout) come from the SX-70 manual and the One-Step 600 teardown, related models; the 1000 may differ.
Inside layout (where the motor, gears and shutter sit) is placed so the parts fit and the light path works; the only photos of the 1000's inside show the parts taken out.
Eyecup: the photo cast puts its back 15-25 mm behind the body's rear; whether the 140 mm depth includes it is not stated.
